title: Definition of Done Rules
description: Machine-readable encoding of the Evolith Definition of Done. Mandatory checklist for every Technical Story before it can be marked Done.

rules.title: Code implemented and reviewed
rules.description: All implementation code is written and at least one peer review approval exists. Self-review does not count.
rules.validationQuery: PR has minimum 1 approved review. No direct push to main/develop.

rules.title: Unit tests meet coverage threshold
rules.description: Unit test coverage for business logic >= 80%. Layer-specific thresholds apply: Domain >= 95%, Application >= 85%, Infrastructure >= 60%.
rules.validationQuery: Coverage report from CI shows >= 80% for business logic. Per-layer thresholds validated.

rules.title: All acceptance criteria verified
rules.description: All acceptance criteria from the Functional Story are verified and pass. Manual or automated verification documented.
rules.validationQuery: All acceptance criteria marked as verified in story tracker. E2E or integration tests confirm criteria.

rules.title: Documentation updated
rules.description: Documentation delta is produced alongside code changes. This includes: updated ADRs if decisions were made, inline code documentation for complex logic, README updates if public interfaces changed.
rules.validationQuery: PR includes documentation changes. Reviewer validates documentation completeness.

rules.title: Observability instrumentation added
rules.description: Production paths have observable telemetry: traces with CorrelationId, structured logs with SessionTrackingId, metrics for key operations.
rules.validationQuery: OTel spans present for production API paths. Logs include required context fields.

rules.title: Security gates passed
rules.description: CodeQL scan passed with zero High/Critical findings. No new CVEs introduced. Secret scanning passed.
rules.validationQuery: CI security gates all green. CodeQL, dependency scan, secret scan passed.

rules.title: ADR created if architectural decision made
rules.description: If the implementation required a new architectural decision (boundary change, technology selection, security model change), an ADR is created and linked to the story.
rules.validationQuery: Architectural decisions documented in ADR. Story links to relevant ADR IDs.

rules.title: Integration tests pass
rules.description: Integration tests (adapter tests with testcontainers) pass. Tests cover persistence adapters, gateway adapters, and inter-service contracts.
rules.validationQuery: Integration test suite passes. Contract tests for inter-service calls pass.

rules.title: Linting and formatting passed
rules.description: All linting rules pass (ESLint, Prettier formatting). No lint errors, no formatting violations.
rules.validationQuery: CI lint step green. No ESLint errors, Prettier formatted.

rules.title: CI pipeline green on target branch
rules.description: CI pipeline runs successfully on the feature branch with all quality gates passing before merge.
rules.validationQuery: All CI checks green. Pipeline completed successfully on feature branch.

exitCriteria.description: All MUST items checked. Story cannot be marked Done without all blocking items satisfied.
